description: M02-U11 case index (m02-plan revision 5 §3, §4): every exit case and claim mapped to its Cargo test targets and tests, per platform. tests: {target: [name | prefix*] | "*"}; a name ending in '*' matches every test whose full name or last segment starts with the rest, and '*' alone is the whole target. Patterns are resolved into required-inventory.json from the build host's sources (m02-evidence.py --generate-inventory) and never from run logs. platform_only: {"<target>" | "<target>::<module>::" | "<target>::<prefix>*" | "<target>::<test>": {"platforms": [...], "rationale": "..."}} says where a test exists and why it exists nowhere else (ADR-0006 §13.13 item 5); the most specific entry wins, and the inventory scan's own entries (#[cfg] gating, read from the cross-built binaries' symbols with platform-tests.py) apply where no case-index entry is more specific. build_host_paths: tests that truly need the build host; remote harnesses skip them, a neutral one counts as run on the build host, any other is a harness gap that keeps the row in_progress. It is empty since ADR-0007 §12.32 item 3: every test that reads repository files (schemas, golden files, snapshots, documents, fixtures, the sources a static scan reads) resolves them through heimdall_testkit::repo::repo_root, which honours HM_REPO_ROOT, and the hook binary through HM_FIXTURE_HOOK; the native harnesses ship those files (lib.sh M02_REPO_DIRS) and set both, so these tests run on every platform. The coverage guard (ADR-0007 §12.47 item 1): on a platform a section declares, a required test that only the inventory scan excludes has no reason on record and keeps that row in_progress (R1, excluded_without_rationale); a unit that keeps a test platform-only adds one platform_only entry for it here, with the platforms where it exists and the rationale. platform_required (per section): {platform: {target: [exact test name]}} lists tests that must pass on that platform; they are never resolved against the inventory, so a planned test that does not exist yet reads as not run and keeps the row in_progress (R2, platform_required_not_passed). Every row reports excluded_on_this_platform. child_entries: #[ignore]d child-process entry points, never required. scenario_targets: harness-defined steps (not Cargo tests) logged in the same format. observation_targets: the Cargo test targets whose tests print `observation` lines (ADR-0007 [I]/[U] facts: exchange and birth-time support, client and Git observations); every remote run uses --show-output, and run-macos.sh runs these once more through cargo with --show-output because check.sh discards passing output. blocked_rows: per case, the platform rows that need an owner input (m02-plan §7), always blocked with that input named.

heimdall_testkit-unit::repo::tests::unse.reason: asserts that the compile-time repository root (the build host's checkout) holds Cargo.toml and schemas/, which exists only where the binary was built; the HM_REPO_ROOT resolution it covers is platform-neutral and its sibling tests run everywhere

e2e_cli_m02::unix::.rationale: Pseudo-terminal cases (#[cfg(unix)]): the owner's typed confirmations (ADR-0006 §3.1) and the CLI prompts on a pty. Their --json and --non-interactive counterparts for uninstall, doctor, setup preview and status and the catalog are e2e_cli_m02::json::* and run on every platform; Windows interactive confirmation is the pseudoconsole drivers' row, which waits on B5 (ADR-0007 §12.32 item 4; ADR-0006 §13.13 item 5). T06's Windows half of the incomplete-rollback case (the kept quarantine, the refused purge) becomes JSON tests (ADR-0007 §12.47 item 4). a21_cli_inventory_wording_never_claims_completeness is here because its Match exec command is POSIX (/usr/bin/touch).

e2e_cli_m02::terminal::.rationale: The pty helpers' own regression (#[cfg(unix)]: rustix ptys); Windows has the pseudoconsole drivers (ADR-0007 §12.32 items 4, 6 and 10).

e2e_run_m02::terminal::.rationale: rustix pty cases (m02-plan U8: 'Unix pty through rustix; Windows pseudoconsole'); the Windows rows are windows_launch ctrlc.* and resize (ADR-0007 §12.44 item 2).

e2e_run_m02::a27_signal_death_preserved.rationale: m02-plan U8 names it '(Unix)': a Windows process has no signal death; its full 32-bit exit code is a27_windows_full_32bit_exit_code_preserved.

e2e_run_m02::a27_not_executable_exits_12.rationale: POSIX 126 for a file without an execute bit (chmod 0644) or a directory; Windows has no execute bit, and its program resolution is PATHEXT-based (a27_windows_current_directory_never_searched, heimdall_launch-unit resolve::tests::windows_*).

e2e_run_m02::a27_child_exit_127_vs_exec_.rationale: Unix exec-in-place states (an exec failure after launching); the Windows sequence is launching, spawned, exited (ADR-0007 §8, §12.43 item 4), proven by a27_windows_spawned_record_is_positive_launch_proof.

e2e_run_m02::a27_kill_between_launching_.rationale: the pause between launching and exec exists only on the Unix exec path; the Windows sequence is launching, spawned, exited (ADR-0007 §8, §12.43 item 4), proven by a27_windows_spawned_record_is_positive_launch_proof.

e2e_run_m02::a27_exec_failure_with_faile.rationale: an exec failure on the Unix exec path with the --meta-fd write failing; the Windows sequence is launching, spawned, exited (ADR-0007 §8, §12.43 item 4), proven by a27_windows_spawned_record_is_positive_launch_proof.

e2e_run_m02::a27_meta_unavailable_aborts.rationale: run --meta-fd is Unix only (sys::adopt_inherited_fd; ADR-0007 §12.15 item 8 E1); the --meta-file protocol runs on every platform.

e2e_run_m02::a27_sigpipe_ignored_by_call.rationale: SIGPIPE is POSIX; the test records a limitation, not fidelity (m02-plan U8).

e2e_run_m02::a11::a11_confirm_constraine.rationale: drives a disposable OpenSSH ssh-agent (ssh-add -c / -x); the Windows native agent is the system service, whose rows, incl. the confirm-constrained one, are blocked on B4 (m02-plan §7).

e2e_run_m02::a11::a11_inherited_confirm_.rationale: drives a disposable OpenSSH ssh-agent (ssh-add -c / -x); the Windows native agent is the system service, whose rows, incl. the confirm-constrained one, are blocked on B4 (m02-plan §7).

e2e_run_m02::a11::a11_interactive_connec.rationale: ADR-0007 §12.47 item 3 (D2/D3): deferred to M04 (deferred_with_decision row of this case): the interactive connect after provider approval is a pty case; its non-interactive twins run natively, and M04 adds the pseudoconsole driver for connect.

e2e_tui_m02::pty::.rationale: ADR-0007 §12.47 item 3 (D2/D3): deferred to M04 (deferred_with_decision row of this case): the TUI pty cases; their model twins (heimdall-unit tui::model::tests) run natively, the Windows pseudoconsole path of heimdall run is windows_launch (§12.44 item 2), and M04 adds the TUI pseudoconsole driver.

heimdall_launch-unit::unix::.rationale: the Unix exec path (crates/launch/src/lib.rs: #[cfg(unix)] pub mod unix); Windows has heimdall_launch-unit::windows::tests (platform_extra).

heimdall_launch-unit::handoff::tests::ca.rationale: POSIX job-control signals (handoff.rs: SIGINT/SIGQUIT handlers, SIGTSTP default); Windows uses the console control guard of crate::windows.

heimdall_launch-unit::handoff::tests::ch.rationale: POSIX process groups (no setpgid); Windows has no process groups in this sense and uses the console control guard of crate::windows.

heimdall_launch-unit::resolve::tests::un.rationale: Unix PATH rules (':'-separated, execute bit); the Windows rules are resolve::tests::windows_* (which run everywhere) and a27_windows_current_directory_never_searched.

heimdall_launch-unit::meta::tests::fd_pr.rationale: run --meta-fd is Unix only (sys::adopt_inherited_fd; ADR-0007 §12.15 item 8 E1); the --meta-file protocol runs on every platform.

heimdall_launch-unit::meta::tests::stdio.rationale: run --meta-fd is Unix only (sys::adopt_inherited_fd; ADR-0007 §12.15 item 8 E1); the --meta-file protocol runs on every platform.

heimdall_launch-unit::meta::tests::a_clo.rationale: run --meta-fd is Unix only (sys::adopt_inherited_fd; ADR-0007 §12.15 item 8 E1); the --meta-file protocol runs on every platform (the fork gate around inherited descriptors).

integration_doctor::a21_fifo_include_doe.rationale: m02-plan U3: 'a Unix mkfifo fixture'; Windows has no FIFO in the file system.

integration_adapters::a11_locked_native_.rationale: drives a disposable OpenSSH ssh-agent (ssh-add -c / -x); the Windows native agent is the system service, whose rows, incl. the confirm-constrained one, are blocked on B4 (m02-plan §7).

integration_testkit_fixtures::f23_confir.rationale: drives a disposable OpenSSH ssh-agent (ssh-add -c / -x); the Windows native agent is the system service, whose rows, incl. the confirm-constrained one, are blocked on B4 (m02-plan §7).

integration_projection::a22_symlinked_us.rationale: m02-plan §4: symlink cases are platform_only Unix (std::os::unix::fs::symlink). The Windows file-symlink row is its own test, a22_windows_file_symlink_user_config_is_manual_mode (A22 platform_required; ADR-0007 §12.47 item 7), and the junction row is a22_windows_reparse_point_user_config_is_manual_mode.

integration_projection::a22_race_symlink.rationale: m02-plan §4: symlink cases are platform_only Unix (std::os::unix::fs::symlink). The Windows file-symlink row is its own test, a22_windows_file_symlink_user_config_is_manual_mode (A22 platform_required; ADR-0007 §12.47 item 7), and the junction row is a22_windows_reparse_point_user_config_is_manual_mode.

integration_projection_replace::race_sym.rationale: m02-plan §4: symlink cases are platform_only Unix (std::os::unix::fs::symlink). The Windows file-symlink row is its own test, a22_windows_file_symlink_user_config_is_manual_mode (A22 platform_required; ADR-0007 §12.47 item 7), and the junction row is a22_windows_reparse_point_user_config_is_manual_mode.

integration_projection::a22_crlf_bom_no_.rationale: #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]: the round trip needs a client the encoding table (localenv clients.rs ENCODING_OBSERVATIONS) records as accepting CRLF, and at ce21a76f only macOS 10.3p1 has a row. Linux: the devbox's OpenSSH 9.6p1 has no row, so a CRLF user configuration there is manual mode (fails closed) and the round trip is not reachable. Windows: ADR-0007 §12.47 item 5 (D5) adds 9.5p2, after which the test must run there too (A22 platform_required); widen this entry when it does.
